sections.title: shape-probe
sections.summary: 11/12 passed; shape-001 found JSON/YAML duplicate-key divergence.
sections.context_text: Mock failed session; shape-probe ran 12 nested-value iterations and found shape-001: duplicate-key JSON/YAML inputs diverge before rendering.

findings.expected_oracle: JSON and YAML duplicate-key inputs have documented equivalent behavior
findings.observed_result: JSON exits 0 and renders 2; YAML exits 2 with ERR_CONFIG_PARSE duplicate entry
findings.requirement_trace: No existing requirement/ADR selects the duplicate-key policy across JSON and YAML.
findings.requirement_follow_up: Ask the product owner to choose reject-or-last-value semantics; create or update the requirement/ADR only after that supported behavior is decided.
findings.root_cause: The JSON and YAML loaders apply different duplicate-key policies before values reach the renderer.
findings.recommended_fix: Document the duplicate-key policy, align both loaders, and add JSON/YAML parity regression tests.

sections.title: template-probe
sections.summary: 11/12 passed; template-001 is inconclusive pending a scalar-typing decision.
sections.context_text: Mock failed session; template-probe ran 12 Jinja behavior iterations and found template-001 inconclusive because CLI and var-file scalar typing differ.

findings.minimal_template: {% if n == 157 %}X{% elif n > 0 %}Y{% else %}Z{% endif %}\n
findings.expected_oracle: X if --var numeric coercion is part of the contract
findings.observed_result: exit 0 with Y; var-file numeric input produces X
findings.requirement_trace: No requirement/ADR currently states whether CLI scalar variables are coerced to numbers.
findings.requirement_follow_up: Have product ownership decide whether CLI scalar typing is intentional; create or update a requirement/ADR only if the decision establishes a supported contract.
findings.root_cause: CLI variables arrive as strings while var-file numbers arrive as numeric values.
findings.recommended_fix: Record the product decision, then add a focused coercion/parity test or document the intentional distinction.

sections.title: boundary-probe
sections.summary: 9/12 passed; boundary-001, boundary-002, and boundary-003 reproduced three confirmed bugs.
sections.context_text: Mock failed session; boundary-probe ran 12 malformed-input and diagnostic iterations. boundary-001, boundary-002, and boundary-003 reproduced three failures; exact templates, inputs, root causes, and requirement follow-ups are in the companion panel.

findings.minimal_template:
UTF-8 bytes EF BB BF followed by ---
variables:
  name:
    required: false
---
Hello {{name}}
findings.expected_oracle: UTF-8 BOM is accepted before frontmatter; output contains only the rendered body
findings.observed_result: exit 0; stdout includes the complete frontmatter block before Hello x
findings.requirement_trace: No requirement or ADR currently covers this BOM-frontmatter behavior.
findings.requirement_follow_up: Assess support first; create/update the requirement/ADR only for a genuine supported-contract gap.
findings.root_cause: The file-frontmatter path does not strip the leading UTF-8 BOM before delimiter detection.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a CLI regression test and normalize a leading BOM if supported.

findings.minimal_input: invalid UTF-8 bytes ff fe in the template body
findings.expected_oracle: nonzero exit with a template/config UTF-8 diagnostic
findings.observed_result: exit 2 with ERR_INCLUDE_NOT_FOUND naming the template itself
findings.requirement_trace: No requirement or ADR currently covers the exact invalid-UTF-8 diagnostic wording.
findings.requirement_follow_up: Confirm the supported diagnostic boundary; create/update an ADR only if stable UTF-8 diagnostics are a supported contract.
findings.root_cause: The invalid byte path is classified by include resolution before template decoding.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a regression test and align error classification with the documented boundary.

findings.expected_oracle: missing declared required variable reports ERR_VAL_MISSING_REQUIRED
findings.requirement_trace: The required-variable diagnostic contract needs reconciliation in existing documents.
findings.requirement_follow_up: Update an existing requirement/ADR if one defines the behavior; create a new one only for a genuine supported-contract gap.
findings.root_cause: Required-variable metadata is not applied before undeclared-token validation.
findings.recommended_fix: Reconcile validation ordering and add a CLI regression test.
